title: SQS, SNS, EventBridge or Kinesis: which one does the stem want?

questions.ask: Is the only job to deliver a stream into S3 or Redshift?
Must several applications read the same ordered records, and read them again?
Does each message go to one worker: buffer, decouple, retry later?
questions.yes: Amazon SQS (FIFO if order or exactly-once matters)

questions.ask: Routing by content, AWS service or SaaS events, a schedule, or replay after a fix?

otherwise: Amazon SNS: fan out to known subscribers, including email, SMS and mobile push
caption: Read from the top: the first question answered yes names the service, and order is always per group or key.
